label.purpose: Names categories, dock controls, and component states.

detail.purpose: Carries Usage and Accessibility explanations and lists.

code.purpose: Shows Shiki-highlighted source in Code and Usage.

shadows.name: prompt-card

shadows.name: floating-menu

shadows.name: fixed-dock-depth

components.name: Active Catalog Item
components.description: Marks the component shown in the workbench.
components.css: .ds-catalog-item { width: 280px; height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.64 0.19 257); border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.64 0.19 257) 8%, oklch(0.19 0.007 255)); color: oklch(0.965 0.003 255); font: 520 12.8px/1.4 Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-catalog-item span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.64 0.19 257); } .ds-catalog-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.64 0.19 257); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Preview Tab
components.description: Switches between the live preview and source code.
components.css: .ds-tab { position: relative; height: 46px; padding: 0 4px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.965 0.003 255); font: 520 12px/1 Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-tab::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: oklch(0.64 0.19 257); content: ''; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.64 0.19 257); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Prompt Composer
components.description: Compact Beautiful UI prompt bar with ghost plus, ink send, and a raised source menu.
components.css: .ds-prompt { width: 420px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.01 255); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(0.19 0.007 255); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.965 0.003 255) 6%, transparent), 0 8px 24px color-mix(in oklab, black 8%, transparent); } .ds-prompt:focus-within { border-color: oklch(0.4 0.012 255); } .ds-prompt input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; height: 28px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.965 0.003 255); font: 400 13px/18px Geist, sans-serif; outline: 0; } .ds-prompt button:first-child { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.68 0.012 255); } .ds-prompt button:last-child { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.965 0.003 255); color: oklch(0.19 0.007 255); } .ds-prompt button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.4 0.012 255); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Install Details Toggle
components.description: Opens the in-place Usage and Accessibility disclosure from the fixed dock.
components.css: .ds-install-toggle { width: 420px; min-height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.68 0.012 255); font: 520 11.52px/1.4 Geist, sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: background 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-install-toggle:hover { background: oklch(0.225 0.008 255); color: oklch(0.965 0.003 255); } .ds-install-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.64 0.19 257); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-install-label, .ds-details-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-install-label { color: oklch(0.965 0.003 255); font-weight: 560; } .ds-install-label > span { color: oklch(0.64 0.19 257); }

components.name: Install Command
components.description: Shows the source-install command with an attached copy action.
components.html: bunx shadcn@latest add http://localhost:3000/r/prompt-composer.json
components.css: .ds-install { width: 470px; height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: stretch; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.01 255); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.19 0.007 255); } .ds-install code { min-width: 0; flex: 1; overflow: auto; padding: 11px 13px; color: oklch(0.68 0.012 255); font: 400 11.2px/1 'Geist Mono', monospace; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-install button { width: 52px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.01 255); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.68 0.012 255); } .ds-install button:hover { background: oklch(0.225 0.008 255); color: oklch(0.965 0.003 255); } .ds-install button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.64 0.19 257); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Highlighted TSX Code

components.css: .ds-code { width: 620px; max-width: 100%; min-height: 220px; overflow: auto; margin: 0; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.01 255); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.19 0.007 255); color: oklch(0.965 0.003 255); font: 400 11.84px/1.7 'Geist Mono', monospace; white-space: pre; } .ds-keyword { color: #ff7b8b; } .ds-string { color: #8fc5ff; } .ds-function { color: #c8a0ff; } .ds-tag { color: #79b8ff; } .ds-code:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.64 0.19 257); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Expanded Details Drawer
components.description: Keeps Usage and Accessibility attached to the fixed install dock and stacks them on mobile.
components.html:
Usage

Import the component and keep its source inside your application.

import { PromptComposer } from "@/components/ui/uai/prompt-composer"

Accessibility

Each registry item ships with its interaction semantics intact.

  • ✓ Persistent accessible label
  • ✓ Named icon-only actions
components.css: .ds-details { width: 900px; max-width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 48px; padding: 24px 28px 28px; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.01 255); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.01 255); background: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(0.145 0.006 255) 92%, oklch(0.19 0.007 255)); color: oklch(0.965 0.003 255); font-family: Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-details section { min-width: 0; } .ds-details h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 13.12px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-details p, .ds-details li { color: oklch(0.68 0.012 255); font-size: 11.84px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-details pre { max-width: 100%; overflow: auto; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.01 255); border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.19 0.007 255); color: oklch(0.965 0.003 255); font: 400 11.84px/1.7 'Geist Mono', monospace; } .ds-details pre span { color: #ff7b8b; } .ds-details ul { padding: 0; list-style: none; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-details { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; padding-inline: 16px; } }

narrative.overview: Uai has two visual layers. The registry workbench is a precise developer tool: a dense catalog rail, graphite surfaces, and cobalt for location and focus. Distributed components are product chrome. They follow the compact Beautiful UI language: 14px surfaces, 28px ghost controls, ink send, and raised menus.
keyCharacteristics: Dense catalog navigation with a stable 312px desktop rail.
One Components destination with no global documentation search or parallel docs shell.
Flat graphite workbench surfaces separated by hairline borders.
Compact type with mono reserved for commands, shortcuts, and code.
Sparse cobalt signals for workbench state. Ink send on Prompt Composer.
Five real registry items, highlighted TSX, install commands, and accessibility notes in one workbench.

rules.name: The Sparse Signal Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt only for workbench state and focus. Do not use it as a decorative fill.

rules.name: The Ink Send Rule
rules.body: Prompt Composer send uses Primary Ink on Graphite Surface when the field can submit. Idle send uses Border Strong. Do not paint send cobalt.

rules.name: The Utility Type Rule
rules.body: Reserve mono for commands, code, shortcuts, and the Uai wordmark.

rules.name: The Divider-Led Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal changes before adding elevation. Reserve wide shadows for the dock and for floating menus.

rules.name: The Floating Menu Rule
rules.body: Menus open from the control that spawned them. They use 14px corners, 4px padding, a visible outline, and a pop-in from scale(0.96) in 180ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1).

dos: Do preserve the 312px catalog and flexible workbench split on desktop.
Do keep the product focused on its single Components destination and verified five-item catalog.
Do use hairline dividers to create hierarchy.
Do keep component states visible together when they help comparison.
Do keep Usage and Accessibility attached to the install dock as an accessible disclosure.
Do use highlighted TSX for both source views and Usage examples.
Do keep cobalt rare and workbench-specific.
Do use ink send, 14px composer corners, and 28px ghost controls on Prompt Composer.
Do give plus and model menus a visible rounded outline and a compact width.
donts: Don't replace the workbench with a marketing hero or card grid.
Don't add gradients, decorative illustrations, or large ambient shadows.
Don't use fictional registry inventory to create density.
Don't reintroduce documentation routes, a global docs search, or a second content shell.
Don't let command or code content create page-level horizontal overflow.
Don't make closed disclosure content focusable or available to pointer interaction.
Don't use mono for general prose.
Don't paint Prompt Composer send cobalt.
Don't ship a square floating menu or a full-bleed slab over the preview.
